releaseNotes: Fix: the 2.8" was rendering upside down. Its boot-time and landscape rotation both changed from 1 to 3 (180 degrees from the old value -- confirmed on real hardware that 1, the usual SPI-board landscape value shared with the 3.5"/AMOLED, was upside down specifically on this model's panel/mounting).
